description: High Speed Internet Access is a dataset listed in City of Oakland open data portal (data.oaklandca.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Oakland. This Indicator measures the percent of individuals living in housing units without access to high speed Internet, defined as broadband Internet service such as cable, fiber optic, or DSL service. Coverage: Oakland. The portal files it under the category Equity Indicators. Its tags are internet, home, equity indicators, equity data, equity. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: American Community Survey, 1-year PUMS. The portal shows 2018-07-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oaklandca-gov-portal.
